FCP.Ranks.RankTrackDef.label: Brotherhood Ranks
FCP.Ranks.RankTrackDef.drillDesc: Drill with any colonist. Both stop, stand apart, and draw their weapons for the session. Both gain skill XP. Once per day.
FCP.Ranks.RankTrackDef.studyDesc: Study scripture and technical texts with another scribe-path colonist. Both gain skill XP. Once per day.
FCP.Ranks.RankTrackDef.inspectDesc: Inspect a lower-ranked colonist's weapon and power armor condition. Well-maintained gear earns a commendation, neglected gear earns a reprimand.
FCP.Ranks.RankTrackDef.punishDesc: Assign a lower-ranked colonist a stretch of extra duties for a discipline lapse, souring their mood. Once per day per colonist.
FCP.Ranks.RankTrackDef.rallyDesc: Rally every combat-ranked member of {0} on this map with a burst of speed and combat effectiveness. Once every few days.
FCP.Ranks.RankTrackDef.fallInDesc: Order {0} to muster behind you in ranks, up to four deep, interrupting whatever they're doing. They'll hold formation until dismissed.
FCP.Ranks.RankTrackDef.dismissDesc: Dismiss {0} from muster, letting them return to their duties.
